limitations: Existing toy-model defects and synthetic metric assumptions remain; passing the education tests does not establish production contracts or learning efficacy.
The prepared runner disables repository conftests, plugin autoload and pytest cache, and verifies selected module/test hashes before importing them.
No notebooks, generators, widget UI, media renderer, native host or provider path executed.
Navigation verification checks actual file targets and presence of planned hrefs, not every Markdown fragment or every pre-existing broken historical link.
The 221 unadapted notebooks remain byte-identical to their frozen original inventory hashes; five adapted notebooks received explicit output/execution-count comparisons.
